zh: 第 2 章双语图版与说明明确区分生成器暂停、底层操作取消和资源清理：背压只约束当前拉取链，独立缓冲区仍需限容；不再把自动取消归因于 async function*。第 6 章补一条实际读取路径：把记忆当线索，核对当前部署与兼容条件，当前证据和本次要求优先，过时条目应修正或删除。

P5 第一刀落在会腐坏的事实上：新增 `yuyu-book/claims.json`，把版本号、价格、数量、默认行为、性能数字与功能标志记成一条条 claim。首批六条覆盖六种 kind——Claude Code 2.1.310 基线、`claude -p` 的 Manual 默认档、附录 B 的 55 个工具、第 13 章的 $3.00 输入价与 72% 缓存节省、附录 C 的 `PROACTIVE` 标志。每条 claim 在中文和英文各有一个 block 定位，却共用同一个 claim_id：自动 block ID 是各文件正文的哈希，两语从不相同，账本负责把它们配成一对。

`yuyu_book/claims.py` 把配对规则变成门禁：`value` 必须同时出现在两侧 quote 里；任一侧引文漂移、block 消失、来源不在 `sources.json`，或只改一侧数字，都在构建前报错。过期分两级：高风险 claim 过期后，`bookctl check` 记 warning，正式构建直接失败；普通风险只记 warning；`retired` 条目保留作历史，不再追正文。第 4 章、第 13 章与附录 C 的中英文正文各补三处稳定 block 标记作锚点。CONTRIBUTING 新增第 5.3 节（断言账本）与第 5.4 节（事实、推断、教学简化、作者建议的标记），提交清单同步加两项。

15 章各补一段最小可运行案例：只用 Python 3.12 标准库，把该章机制压成可执行的教学模型，首行 `# exercise:` 标记、`# expected:` 写明逐行输出；正文交代版本锁、预期结果、前置章节与回链。英文版逐字使用同一段代码，新增 `tests/test_exercises.py` 在每次检查时真正执行这 15 段并比对屏幕输出，同时守住两版代码相同、五个标签齐全、章章恰有一例。
验证：构建器测试 547 项全绿。
en: Chapter 2's paired diagram and explanation distinguish generator suspension, cancellation of pending work, and cleanup: backpressure bounds the pull chain, while independent buffers still need limits; async function* does not cancel work automatically. Chapter 6 adds a concrete reading path: treat memory as a lead, check current deployment and compatibility conditions, prefer current evidence and the present request, and correct or remove stale entries.

P5 starts with the facts that rot: `yuyu-book/claims.json` records versions, prices, counts, defaults, performance numbers and feature flags as individual claims. Six seed claims cover all six kinds -- the Claude Code 2.1.310 baseline, the Manual default for `claude -p`, Appendix B's 55 tools, Chapter 13's $3.00 input price and 72% cache savings, and Appendix C's `PROACTIVE` flag. Each claim has its own block locator in each edition but a single shared claim_id: automatic block IDs hash each file's own text, so the two editions never pair by themselves; the ledger pairs them.

`yuyu_book/claims.py` turns that pairing rule into a gate: `value` must appear in both quotes, and a drifted quote, a vanished block, a source missing from `sources.json`, or a number updated on one side only fails before the build. Expiry has two severities: CI warns on a stale high-risk claim, while a release build refuses it; normal-risk claims only warn, and `retired` entries stay as history without chasing the prose. Chapters 4 and 13 and Appendix C gain three stable block markers in each edition as anchors. CONTRIBUTING now documents the ledger in §5.3 and the fact/inference/teaching-simplification/author-recommendation markers in §5.4, with two new checklist items.

All 15 chapters gain a minimal runnable case: Python 3.12 standard library only, each chapter's mechanism compressed into an executable teaching model, opened by an `# exercise:` marker and followed by `# expected:` lines that state the exact output; the prose gives the version lock, expected result, prerequisite chapter and backlink. Both editions run byte-identical code, and the new `tests/test_exercises.py` executes all 15 on every check, compares stdout, and guards the shared code, the five labels and one case per chapter.
Validation: 547 builder tests green.

zh: 入门分册里同一本书印着两个站数：导读卡片写「18 站」，页内标签写「第 N / 19 站」。数字手抄在卡片模板里，实际站数由分篇表数出来，两者就分叉了。现在站数一律由单元表加附录清单推导，构建时编号站数与声明总数不符即报错停止。
英文版比中文版少走三站：`ORDER_EN` 的附录段只列了 `apxd`，附录 A、B、C 因此没有标题、没有插图、没有「how to use」那行白话，页面上直接印出内部锚点 id。两版共用同一份附录清单后，中文与英文都走满 19 站。
门户、画廊与两本分册页脚的数字改成向构建器和磁盘取：站数取自分册生成器，插图数取自 `illustrations/` 目录，分册对应的大书版本号取自 `manifest.json`。新增 9 项站点契约，五类漂移逐条变异验证会红——插图数改成 25、卡片留在 18 站、分册版本号落后一个补丁、英文站序漏掉附录站、编号站比声明总数少一座；最后一种构建自己就报错停止。
重出分册时发现它带着上一轮改写前的自测题：第 1、4、6 站的「自测一下」还是旧句子，因为正文改了没人重跑这个派生产物。Pages 流水线现在在重生成之后比对仓库里的 `docs/`，不一致就停。

英文书稿第三轮文风修订：15 章共 84 行原地改。78 行补漏掉的冠词、修直译句法（`provides Agent a` → `provides the Agent with a`，`In practice debugging` → `When debugging in practice`）；另 6 行重写结构句——钩子类型的决策树从一串「need X use Y」改成 use Command to run a system command，两处没有主语的「Applicable to … scenarios」补出它说的是哪个模式，反模式清单里说清读到空数据的是谁，降级策略那条换掉含糊的 it。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。

README 报的整书数字来自更早一次构建：中文 PDF 462 页 / 15.5 MB、英文 499 页 / 9.8 MB，两份单文件 HTML 5.4 / 5.5 MB。前几轮改写只重跑了 HTML，`--pdf` 一次也没重排，印出来的页数与体积就这么陈旧下去——而且只改了中文版 README，英文版那一份还留在旧数字上。现在两份都按 CI 的 Noto CJK 实测改成 471 页 / 33.5 MB 与 502 页 / 22.2 MB、HTML 5.5 / 5.6 MB，并写清换一台装了微软雅黑的 Windows 会排成 474 与 515 页——页数跟着构建机那套中文字体走。构建日志新增每份 PDF 的页数，`scripts/check_artifact_claims.py` 在 Book CI 里对着刚排出的 `dist/` 核对两份 README 的页数与 HTML 体积：数字对不上、产物缺失、那句话被改写都退出非零，七次变异逐个验证会红，未变异时绿。两份 README 报的来源条数与单元数另收进既有的数字契约（四项，同样逐个变异验证）。

第五轮修订：中文与英文各 8 行，把替机制下判语的收尾句换回它说的那件事。「这体现了『智能工具』的设计理念」改成工具先读懂命令在做什么、再决定界面怎么收放；「为企业部署提供了灵活性」「消除了不一致的根源」「是一个值得讨论的问题」整句删掉或落到具体行为；前言里「不会因为某个框架的版本更新而过时」换成它站得住的那半句——这些模式不绑定某一个框架的实现；另拆掉一处「同样……同样……同样」的三段式。「这意味着」从 30 处降到 24 处，「This means」从 26 处降到 21 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。

第六轮修订：中文与英文各 9 行，改的是同一个毛病——「这意味着」后面接的常常不是机制，而是把上一句再说一遍。「Ink 是一个使用 React 组件模型渲染终端 UI 的框架」那句改成冒号直接承接它的后果；「schema 定义就是工具的使用说明书」连比喻一起删掉，只留参数描述写在 `describe()` 调用里；「优雅地降级」「极大缩短了延迟」「节省大量 token 消耗」换成降级、延迟与重算本身；「这是一个正确的安全决策」这句判语删掉，让紧跟其后的「去重看的是「实际效果」而非「表面配置」」自己承重；「你应该养成……习惯」改成一句能照做的动作。该行是英文词条 graceful degradation 的证据锚点，改写时只摘连接词、把 degrades 留下。「这意味着」从 24 处降到 15 处，「This means」从 21 处降到 13 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。重排一次印张，微软雅黑那台机器的中文版从 474 页变成 473 页，两份 README 的说明跟着改；

第七轮修订：中英各 10 行，删的是「X 的设计体现了 Y 原则／哲学／模式」这层升格——原则名常常只是把上一句机制改个说法。「最小信息损失」「专门化优于通用化」「集中管控、分散使用」「架构的通用性」这几处让机制自己站住；「纵深防御（Defense in Depth）」「单一所有权」留着术语，但换成管理器和状态归属的动作句；两处「体现了一个重要的工程原则」后面本来就跟着加粗的那条原则，前面只留「这里拆开的是两件事」「这个设计选择背后的原则只有一句」。第 4 章那行是词条 graceful degradation 的中文证据锚点，「优雅降级」原样保留。「体现了」从 33 处降到 23 处，英文 embodies 从 22 处降到 16 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。同一台微软雅黑的 Windows 再排一次，中文整书仍是 473 页、体积从 22.4 MB 变成 22.5 MB，两份 README 的说明跟着实测改；构建器测试 422 项全绿。

第八轮修订：中英各 10 行，清的是第七轮剩下的那批「体现了」——第 1 章的技术栈与按需加载、第 3 章的快速失败、第 4 章的就近原则／信任与能力匹配／先理解后行动、第 6 章的最小权限、第 8 章的用户主权、第 12 章的安全左移、附录 A 的经典设计模式。改法一样：原则名换掉，动作句留下——技术栈照「用正确的工具解决正确的问题」来选，白名单照最小权限原则发放，七种规则来源按「就近原则」排优先级，plan 模式把「先理解后行动」排成两步。第 3 章那行是词条 fail-fast 的证据锚点，「快速失败」与英文 fail fast 原样留着；第 8 章那行英文顺手修了主谓一致（Why does user global settings have highest priority → Why do the user's global settings rank highest）。「体现了」从 23 处降到 13 处，英文 embodies 从 16 处降到 8 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。同一台微软雅黑的 Windows 再排一次，中文整书从 473 页回到 474 页、体积仍是 22.5 MB，英文仍是 515 页 / 9.9 MB，两份 README 的说明跟着实测改；第七轮推送后 Book CI 的产物闸门先报英文整书在 Noto 下排到 503 页、README 还写着 502；这一轮自己推上去，又报中文整书从 471 页变成 472 页、英文体积从 22.2 MB 变成 22.3 MB。两份 README 的 CI 数字都按流水线刚排出来的实测改。构建器测试 422 项全绿。

第九轮修订：中文 13 行、英文 12 行，拆的是「不仅 A，还 B」这副架子——A 常常没人主张过：钩子的输出「不仅是一段 stdout 文本」、可观测性「不仅是记录日志」，真正要说的是 B，于是把 A 删掉或降成从句。钩子的输出就是一段结构化的 JSON 响应协议、由输出解析函数负责解析；生产级 Agent Harness 的可观测性就是一套分层设计；令牌管理有两条线，一条被动等压缩触发、一条主动做预算规划和预警。两处并列如实留下：「人类胶水」那种模式又慢又容易出错，是两个同时成立的后果，不是修辞。第 3 章那行是词条 least-privilege 的中英证据锚点，「最小权限」与 least privilege 原样不动；第 11 章那句英文在第四轮已经重写过，这一轮只动中文，所以两版行数不等。中文「不仅」从 26 处降到 13 处，英文 not only / not just / goes beyond 三类合计从 27 处降到 15 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。同一台微软雅黑的 Windows 再排一次，中文仍是 474 页 / 22.5 MB，英文从 515 页变成 516 页，两份 README 的说明跟着实测改。构建器测试 422 项全绿。

第十轮修订：中文 16 行、英文 13 行，清的是复述式的「这意味着」与「This means」。按缺陷深浅分两种改法：后半句本就等于前半句的，连接词连同整句一起拿掉——「`submitMessage` 是一个 `AsyncGenerator`，这意味着调用者可以实时消费」两句说的是同一件事，记忆条目「先按行截断再按字节截断」后面那句也只是把它拆开重说一遍；英文「完美分叉」的两句并成一句，冒号后面直接接三条后果。确实是新信息的，换个素净的连接词收尾：所以五处、于是三处、因此两处，不再用「意味着」这种把句子往上抬一级的动词。两处拆的是真架子——「实现了一种"竞赛"机制」落回「这是一场"竞赛"」，英文 "implementing a race mechanism" 同样改成 "a race"。中文留下一处在第 14 章的反模式警告里：「如果某个操作需要等待，这说明探索策略需要优化」是从症状推结论，不是复述；英文第 1 章末的 "Understanding this means understanding why…" 是收束句，也不动。第 2 章的背压、第 4 章的分类器、第 5 章的 settings.json 三行是词条的证据锚点，注册词形原样留着。为了不让句首的 So 变成新的口头禅，英文十三处里有七处不带它。中文「这意味着／这说明」从 17 处降到 1 处，英文「This means」从 13 处降到 0 处。改动全部落在同一行内，行数与行号不动，术语注册词形、代码块、Mermaid 标签与引用材料未改，也没有新增技术论断。同一台微软雅黑的 Windows 再排一次，中文仍是 474 页 / 22.5 MB，英文仍是 516 页 / 9.9 MB；推上去以后 Book CI 的产物闸门报英文整书在 Noto 下从 503 页排到 504 页，两份 README 的 CI 数字跟着改成流水线刚排出来的实测。构建器测试 422 项全绿。

en: The on-ramp printed two station counts for one book: the social card said 18 while the labels on the page read “Station N / 19.” The card copied the number by hand; the walk derives it from the part tables. The count now comes from the unit lists plus the appendix stations, and the build stops if the numbered stations and the declared total disagree.

The English edition walked three stations fewer than the Chinese one: `ORDER_EN` listed only `apxd` among the appendices, so Appendix A, B and C shipped without a heading, without a drawing and without their plain-language line — the page printed the internal anchor id where the title should be. Both editions now share one appendix list and run the full 19 stations.

The portal, the gallery and both readers’ footers now ask the builders for their numbers: the station count comes from the reader generator, the plate count from the `illustrations/` directory, and the book edition from `manifest.json`. Nine site contracts pin the derivations and five drift classes were verified by mutation — a plate count set to 25, a card left at 18 stations, a reader one patch behind the book, an appendix station dropped from the English order, a walk one numbered station short of its declared total; the last one stops the build itself.

Re-cutting the readers found them carrying quiz questions from before the last style pass: stations 1, 4 and 6 still quoted the old sentences, because nobody re-ran this derived artifact after the prose changed. The Pages workflow now compares docs/ against the regenerated files and stops on a difference.

A third style pass over the English manuscript: 84 lines across 15 chapters. Seventy-eight take the articles they were missing and lose their calque syntax (`provides Agent a` → `provides the Agent with a`, `In practice debugging` → `When debugging in practice`). Six are rebuilt structure: the hook-type decision tree stops reading as a chain of “need X use Y” and becomes use Command to run a system command, the two subject-less “Applicable to … scenarios” lines say which pattern they mean, the anti-pattern list names the worker left reading empty data, and the degradation bullet drops an ambiguous it. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added.

The README numbers came off an older build: 462 pages / 15.5 MB for the Chinese PDF, 499 pages / 9.8 MB for the English one, and 5.4 / 5.5 MB for the two HTML files. The recent passes re-ran the HTML only; nothing re-typeset the PDF, so the printed figures went stale — and the first fix touched the Chinese README, leaving the English one on the old numbers. Both now carry the CI/Noto CJK measurements, 471 pages / 33.5 MB and 502 pages / 22.2 MB with the HTML at 5.5 and 5.6 MB, and both say outright that a Windows machine with Microsoft YaHei paginates to 474 and 515 pages, because the sheet count follows the CJK face on the build machine. The build log names each PDF's page count, and `scripts/check_artifact_claims.py` checks both READMEs' counts and HTML sizes against the dist CI just typeset: a drifted number, a missing artifact, or a reworded sentence exits non-zero. Seven mutations were each verified red, with the unmutated run green. Four further pins put the two READMEs' source and unit counts under the existing document contracts.

A fifth pass, eight lines per edition, replaces the sentences that judged the mechanism with the mechanism: the tool is no longer said to embody an “intelligent tool” philosophy but described reading what a command does and then deciding how the interface folds it away; “providing flexibility for enterprise deployments”, “eliminating the root cause of inconsistencies” and “is a topic worth discussing” are cut or land on the behaviour behind them; the foreword drops its promise that no framework version update will date these patterns and keeps the half it can support — the patterns are not tied to any one framework's implementation; and one run of three “same … same … same” clauses becomes a single list. “This means” falls from 26 uses to 21 in the English chapters and 这意味着 from 30 to 24 in the Chinese. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added.

A sixth pass, nine lines per edition, at the connective that opens a restatement instead of the mechanism: the Ink sentence now carries its own consequence behind a colon, the schema is no longer called the tool's “user manual”, “gracefully degrades”, “greatly shortening the delay” and “save substantial token consumption” give way to the degradation, the delay and the recomputation they were grading, the verdict “this is a correct security decision” is cut so the principle behind it carries the sentence, and “you should develop the habit” becomes the action it was pointing at. The English line anchoring the graceful-degradation gloss keeps its word degrade and loses only the connective. “This means” falls from 21 uses to 13 and 这意味着 from 24 to 15. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added. Re-typesetting moved the Chinese edition from 474 to 473 pages on the Microsoft YaHei machine, which both READMEs now say;

A seventh pass, ten lines per edition, at the sentence that promotes a mechanism into a named principle: “X’s design embodies the Y principle” usually just renames the clause before it. “Minimum information loss”, “specialization over generalization”, “centralized control, distributed usage” and “architectural versatility” step aside for the behaviour itself, while “Defense in Depth” and “single ownership” keep their terms but become what the manager and the state actually do; the two lines that announced “an important engineering principle” then printed the principle in bold, so the announcement becomes a plain “two things come apart here”. The Chapter 4 line anchoring the graceful-degradation gloss keeps its 优雅降级 untouched. 体现了 falls from 33 uses to 23 and “embodies” from 22 to 16. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added. Re-typesetting on the Microsoft YaHei machine holds the Chinese edition at 473 pages but 22.5 MB instead of 22.4, which both READMEs now say; 422 builder tests green.

An eighth pass, ten lines per edition, clearing the “embodies” the seventh pass left behind: the Chapter 1 stack and load-on-demand lines, Chapter 3's fail-fast rule, Chapter 4's proximity ordering, trust-matching-capability ranking and understand-before-acting workflow, Chapter 6's least-privilege allowlist, Chapter 8's user sovereignty, Chapter 12's shift-left approval and Appendix A's design patterns. Same repair: the named principle gives way to what the code does -- the stack is picked by the right-tool-for-the-right-problem test, the allowlist is issued against Least Privilege, the seven rule sources rank by proximity, plan mode splits understanding from acting. The Chapter 3 line anchoring the fail-fast gloss keeps 快速失败 and “fail fast”; the Chapter 8 line also lost its agreement error (“Why does user global settings have highest priority” is now “Why do the user's global settings rank highest”). 体现了 falls from 23 uses to 13 and “embodies” from 16 to 8. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added. Re-typesetting on the Microsoft YaHei machine puts the Chinese edition back at 474 pages / 22.5 MB while the English one holds at 515 pages / 9.9 MB, which both READMEs now say; the artifact gate caught the seventh pass printing the English book at 503 Noto pages against a README claiming 502, and caught this pass moving the Chinese book from 471 to 472 Noto pages and the English file from 22.2 to 22.3 MB; both READMEs now quote what the pipeline just typeset; 422 builder tests green.

A ninth pass, thirteen lines in Chinese and twelve in English, at the frame “not only A but also B”: A is often something nobody claimed -- hook output is “not just stdout text”, observability “goes beyond logging” -- while B is the point, so A is deleted or demoted into a subordinate clause. Hook output is a structured JSON response protocol that the output parsing function parses; observability in a production-grade harness is a layered design; token management runs on two tracks, one reactive waiting for a compression trigger, one proactive doing budget planning and early warning. Two genuine pairings stay: the human-glue pattern is slow and error-prone, two consequences that hold at once rather than a figure of speech. The Chapter 3 line anchoring the least-privilege gloss keeps 最小权限 and “least privilege” untouched, and the Chapter 11 sentence had already been rebuilt in the fourth pass, so that one is Chinese-only and the two editions differ by a line. 不仅 falls from 26 uses to 13; “not only”, “not just” and “goes beyond” together fall from 27 to 15. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added. Re-typesetting on the Microsoft YaHei machine holds the Chinese edition at 474 pages / 22.5 MB and moves the English one from 515 to 516 pages, which both READMEs now say; 422 builder tests green.

A tenth pass, sixteen lines in Chinese and thirteen in English, at the restatement opener 这意味着 / "This means". Two repairs, sorted by how deep the defect goes. Where the second sentence only re-says the first, the connector goes with it: "submitMessage is an AsyncGenerator, which means callers can consume messages as they arrive" says one thing twice, and so does the truncation-order line that unpacks "by lines first, then by bytes"; the English "perfect fork" collapses two sentences into one with a colon before its three consequences. Where the consequence is new information, a plain connective does the job -- five 所以, three 于是, two 因此 -- instead of a verb that lifts the sentence up a level. Two frames were real scaffolding: 实现了一种"竞赛"机制 comes back down to 这是一场"竞赛", and "implementing a race mechanism" becomes simply "a race". One Chinese line is left as it is, in Chapter 14's anti-pattern warning: 如果某个操作需要等待，这说明探索策略需要优化 infers from a symptom rather than restating one, and Chapter 1's closing "Understanding this means understanding why…" is a wrap-up, not a tell. The three evidence anchors -- 背压 in Chapter 2, 分类器 in Chapter 4, settings.json in Chapter 5 -- keep their registered forms. To keep sentence-initial "So" from becoming the next tic, seven of the thirteen English lines carry no "So" at all. 这意味着/这说明 falls from 17 uses to 1 and "This means" from 13 to 0. Every edit stays inside its line, so line counts and evidence anchors still resolve; registered term forms, code blocks, Mermaid labels and quoted material are untouched, and no technical claim was added. Re-typesetting on the Microsoft YaHei machine holds the Chinese edition at 474 pages / 22.5 MB and the English one at 516 pages / 9.9 MB; the artifact gate then caught the English book printing 504 Noto pages where both READMEs still said 503, and the CI numbers now quote what the pipeline just typeset; 422 builder tests green.

An eleventh pass, ten lines in each edition, at the not-X-but-Y frame: it erects a position nobody argued for and then knocks it over, and the payload is the half that survives, so the first half goes with the scaffolding. "Team deletion is not a simple \"delete everything\" operation but a process with multiple safety checks" becomes "Deleting a team runs several safety checks first", with all three checks still listed below it; "These changes aren't simple feature additions, but a refactoring of the core data model" lands as "These changes land in the core data model"; chapter 8's "This embodies the engineering philosophy that ..." drops the wrapper so the claim ends the paragraph, and the same line picks up the articles it was missing (creates a new object, returns the same reference). Contrasts that carry the argument stay: chapter 4 still opens by saying the pipeline is not one "allow/deny" switch but a multi-stage checking mechanism, which is what the pipeline is shaped like — there the cut was only the self-praising "simple / carefully designed" pair. Counted inside a single sentence (Chinese 不是/并非……而是 within 60 characters, English is/are not … but within 80), the frame falls from 43 to 35 in Chinese and 86 to 78 in English. Chapter 1 opened and closed on the same clause, "mutually reinforcing network of architectural decisions"; the two now read "make up" and "interlock", keeping the author's bookend without the restatement. Line counts and evidence anchors hold — the only anchor line touched was 04:11, where session stays put. This box's Microsoft YaHei run now typesets 475 Chinese pages / 22.5 MB and 515 English pages / 10.0 MB, and both READMEs quote those local numbers; the artifact gate then caught the Chinese book printing 473 Noto pages where both READMEs still said 472, so the CI numbers now quote what the pipeline just typeset. 422 builder tests green.

A twelfth pass, twelve lines in each edition, at the empty verb trailing off the end of a sentence: 确保了 / "ensures". The shape is two sentences that state the mechanism, then a third that promotes what was just said into an outcome. QueryEngine now simply puts terminal use and API calls on the same verified core path -- the path is the mechanism; the tree-shaking line says external builds carry no internal tool code; the `> 0` guard ends on "query usage at any moment and the number you get is the largest seen so far"; the three-phase lifecycle becomes "each phase owns its own resources, so nothing leaks". Where the verb does real work it stays: 压缩策略如何保证不丢失关键信息 asks for a property the strategy must hold, not a restatement. Counted on the word itself, 确保 falls from 51 to 39 and, with 保证, from 194 to 182 in Chinese; ensures/ensuring falls from 157 to 145 in English, and the "This design/pattern/approach ensures" opener from 5 to 2. Two new tics were watched for on the way: connectives stay scattered (two 因此, one 于是, one 有了, eight lines carrying none) and no two adjacent English sentences open with "Each layer". Chapter 3 line 138 and chapter 10 line 73 are gloss evidence anchors -- 功能开关 / tree-shaking and 会话记录 keep their registered forms -- and every edit stays inside its line, so line numbers still resolve. This box's Microsoft YaHei run now typesets 475 Chinese pages / 22.4 MB and 516 English pages / 10.0 MB, and both READMEs quote those local numbers. 422 builder tests green.

A thirteenth pass, twelve lines in each edition, at the 使得 / enables scaffold: the sentence right after the mechanism says "this design enables X to Y", promoting what was just stated into an outcome and parking a spent verb inside Y. The foreword now reads "Their carefully designed product architecture is what this analysis rests on" -- "makes in-depth technical analysis possible" was the whole payload of the old sentence. Chapter 3 line 94 has every render method return `React.ReactNode`, "so the tool system plugs straight into the React rendering pipeline", and the same line loses its "This design choice means that" wrapper; chapter 7 becomes "The boundary marker tells later compression runs \"which messages have already been compressed,\" so they do not get compressed twice", shorter than the "presence of the boundary marker enables subsequent compression operations to accurately identify" it replaced; chapter 15 ends on "Real-time UI updates and streaming out to SDK consumers build on that yield". A fifteenth round spent on the pictures rather than the sentences.
