English follows on 14 lines: 'tool call is allowed to continue' became 'the tool call goes ahead', 'Plugin hooks and built-in hooks are assigned lowest priority values in sorting' became 'Sorting hands plugin hooks and built-in hooks the lowest priority values', and 'every one of these assumptions will be violated' became 'a real production environment breaks every one of these assumptions'. Round 37's lost-base-form trap stayed avoided: gloss hits held at zh 294 / en 298 the whole way. One line for one line: 4 Markdown files, 29 lines in balance, per-file line counts unchanged, no glosses.json file:line anchor moved. Wall length moved in one place, honestly recorded: ch01's longest wall grew 8 characters, 2507 to 2515 against a 2885 ceiling, while the same en section shrank from 7040 to 7011; the foreword, ch02 and ch15 walls kept their length. build.py --check passed; 422 builder tests green, plus 27 in the repository suite; check_book.py reports 90 Markdown files and 320 Mermaid diagrams with 0 errors; npm run check:diagrams agrees. The rest of the 被x is spread thin across ch03, ch05, ch07 and ch13 at 7-8 lines each.

Round 39 is the first sweep that starts from the English side. Earlier rounds chased Chinese 被 sentences and nobody had ever measured the English passive. Measuring two shapes in the 20 units' prose walls — be + past participle, and can/must/will be + past participle — gives 194 lines. This round takes the densest unit, ch03: it holds 17 of those lines and drops to 4, bringing the book-wide total to 181; the matching Chinese section goes from 8 被x lines to 0. Same method — put the actor back in the sentence: 'Feature flags come from the build toolchain and are evaluated by the bundler at compile time' became 'The build toolchain hands feature flags to the bundler, which evaluates them at compile time'; 'When a tool is renamed, the old name can continue to match through an alias' became 'Rename a tool and the old name keeps matching through an alias'; 'multiple layers of filtering are applied' became 'the candidates run through several filters'; 'Neither search is handed to BashTool' became 'BashTool gets neither search'. Chinese follows in step: 「都会被 tree-shaking 移除」 became 「开关一关，tree-shaking 就把对应工具的实现代码整段删掉」, and 「它决定了多个工具调用如何被调度、执行和结果收集」 became 「它决定多个工具调用怎么排队、怎么跑、结果怎么收回来」. The prose commit balanced 28 lines, then a follow-up commit corrected a claim in its own message: the surviving 被x line in ch03 is not the technical term 被调用者 but the lifecycle label in the list 开始／进行中／成功／被拒／出错 — a bare label among bare labels, so it reads stiff, and it became 驳回. Numbers written down have to match the thing measured, even when only one word is off. Gloss hits stayed at zh 294 / en 298, no glosses.json anchor moved, and the longest walls kept their length. 422 builder tests green, plus 27 in the repository suite; check_book.py reports 90 Markdown files and 320 Mermaid diagrams with 0 errors; npm run check:diagrams agrees. Of the 181 English passive lines left, ch05 holds 21 and ch02 and ch06 hold 16 each (re-measured at the end of this round, not the pre-round figures) — the next targets.

Round 40 carries the English passive sweep to ch05, the settings and configuration chapter. It holds 21 of the remaining passive lines and drops to zero, taking the 20-unit prose-wall total from 181 lines to 160; the chapter's 8 Chinese 被 lines clear too, bringing the book-wide total from 31 to 27. This round also corrects a measuring error: commit 3da4dc0 claimed "3 lines left book-wide", but that figure came from the boundary-gated pattern  e?被[一-龥], which only catches a 被 preceded by a non-Hanzi token such as "hooks 被跳过", whereas the ledger has counted with the ungated 被[一-龥] since round 38. On the right pattern ch05 had gone from 8 to 4, not 4 to 0, so four more lines needed work before the chapter was actually clean. English puts the actor back in the sentence: "Different levels of access are controlled by different trust levels" becomes "Your trust level decides what you may open"; "plugin settings are loaded first as the base for merging, and subsequent configuration layers are stacked on top of this base" becomes "The loader reads plugin settings first and treats them as the merge base, then stacks every other configuration layer on top"; "The default state is constructed by getDefaultAppState()" becomes "getDefaultAppState() builds the default state". One line for one line (en 21/21, zh 8/8), no line numbers move, every glosses.json file:line anchor stays where it is, the marked-term counts hold at zh 294 / en 298, 422 builder tests green, plus 27 in the repository suite.

Round 41 opens a channel for hand-drawn plates inside the prose. The 26 SVGs previously had exactly three homes — chapter emblem, part headpiece, cover plate — and nothing could sit in the body; now an ill fence holding one drawing name becomes a hash-tagged drawing placeholder at build time and is inlined from illustrations/ as <figure class="illu …">, borrowing the Mermaid caption rule (nearest preceding H2) and numbering alongside the diagrams: the bench is Figure 3-2, the filmstrip Figure 3-6. Drawings go 26 to 28 and plates 160 to 162 per language (the 320 Mermaid diagrams halve to 160, plus these two). Both traps came from actually running the build: closing an ill fence without resetting the buffer let the following bash fence body be read as a drawing name ('an ill fence holds one drawing name, not …'), and IllusBlock.line, measured at insertion time, pointed the caption lookup above where the placeholder really sits once the blank-line pass pushed every later row down — it is now measured from the final body. Revert either one and the new tests go red (1 failure plus 3 errors), so they are not decoration. The sequential plate is deliberately two-layer: in HTML the four frames light up one at a time as the strip scrolls, hovering switches to a plain clock (ink-cycle 2.8s, +.7s per frame, with animation-timeline:auto and animation-range:normal written out to escape the scroll timeline), and print plus prefers-reduced-motion fall back to the fully inked static strip — the filmstrip the PDF carries. A plate declares its own motion (only a root class of seq earns the hover-to-play hint), so the prose never says how to animate it. Prose still went one line for one line: ch03 gained 11 lines and rewrote 1 in each language (wc -l 459 to 469), each plate earning a lead-in — 「把内建工具想成一张工作台：每件家伙什只管一件事。」 / 'Think of the built-in tools as one workbench: every tool on the wall does exactly one job.' — with the assembly-line sentence appended to the analogy. Anchor totals held at 408 in glosses.json and 158 in manifest.json while 38 and 6 occurrences shifted (+6 and +10), all inside ch03's two files; marked terms stayed zh 294 / en 298. Around it: audit now fails on an unresolved drawing placeholder, art.drawing() runs on the 20 KB plate budget while photo() accepts only a data URI under 300 KB (the next step for real photographs), the gallery generator refuses to ship when its ORDER and the drawing shelf disagree, the four site pages were regenerated, and README / STRUCTURE / CREDITS moved from 26 to 28. A new yuyu-book/tests/test_illustrations.py adds 18 tests over the fence, the line numbers, the captions, line versus seq figures, missing-drawing and orphan-placeholder errors, zh/en slot parity, and every real slot hanging a compliant drawing. 440 builder tests green, plus 27 in the repository suite; build.py --check passes (20 units, 162 plates, 294/298 glosses); check_book.py reports 90 Markdown files and 320 Mermaid diagrams with 0 errors; npm run check:diagrams agrees. Both new drawings were inspected in the browser: they re-ink in currentColor on the dark sheet, caption and play hint in place.This round's own ledger note tripped that gate: it quoted the placeholder token in its raw form, so audit read the revision page as two unresolved plates and failed both modes; describing the token in words instead made render and source pass again — the gate is deliberately dumb, so prose must not pretend to be markup.

The filmstrip layer now has its own contract. The emblem layer's guards have been pinned for a while, but nothing checked the rules the body plates inherit — and four more strips are about to land on top of them. Two tests close it: every `.illu-seq` rule has to sit behind the @supports probe, the hover layer has to clear the scroll range it inherits and stay last in source order, and the print sheet may not carry ink-cycle; the other reads the drawings off disk and insists that any file whose root says seq puts its frame groups first, four to six of them. Three old debts are cleared alongside it, all the same failure — one figure written into several documents but pinned in only one: the English README spelled its illustration count as a word and had gone stale at twenty-six while the shelf held 28, the style-system row in CREDITS quotes the same 28 with nothing watching it, and STRUCTURE's count of plates inside the prose was a loose number that the build now recomputes from the ill fences themselves. 442 builder tests green.

The dialog loop now has its own four-frame strip. Section 2.2 is about one message in and one out, and it already carried two flowcharts: one strings the five phases into a control flow and draws the road back to phase one on the graph itself, the other sorts ten stop conditions into three kinds. The strip fills no information gap — it changes how you read. The division of labour settled in round 41 says Mermaid shows how the machine turns and the hand-inked line leaves you the few gestures you can recall with your eyes shut. Four cells now sit side by side — a question in a bubble, the tool call the model hands back, a gear turning once in front of the permission gate, three results written back before the next line — with an arc over the strip leading the fourth cell home to the first. A plate costs the prose six lines, so the 28 anchors in the two registries that point past line 289 each move by six; the shift script does the arithmetic and the build's plain-language check re-reads every one of them, failing the build if a single pointer lands wrong. The two language files stay line-for-line aligned (445 to 451 lines each). Hand-inked drawings 28 to 29, plates inside the prose 2 to 3, plates per edition 162 to 163. 442 builder tests green.

Section 1.3 has a portico. The Mermaid graph at the top of the section already gives each of the five principles a box and links the boxes with arrows, which is a statement about how they fit together; this drawing adds the other thing — the five each own a subsection and readers came away remembering only “five of them”, so now they are a portico, five objects under one lintel — three rippling strokes, a ring set inside its own frame, a three-drawer stack with a tag, steps climbing one above the last, a crate under a stamped check. This plate never staggers: its root carries no seq, so it inks its lines and stops, which is also what proves the frame-order test only picks up strips and leaves single drawings alone. The block lands after line 384, and the shift script reported zero anchors back of it — the registries never quote ch01 that far down, so this round's arithmetic is an honest 0, which only shows up as 0 if you run it. Both language files go from 463 to 469 lines. Hand-inked drawings 29 to 30, plates inside the prose 3 to 4, plates per edition 163 to 164. 442 builder tests green.

The permission pipeline now shows its four gates. Section 4.1 splits one tool call into validateInput, hasPermissionsToUseTool, checkPermissions and the interactive prompt, but the section is not bare: three Mermaid diagrams already hang on it — a top-down pipeline, a ranking of the eight settings sources by priority, and a sequenceDiagram whose alt/else splits that last stage far more finely than this strip does, because it is drawing a negotiation between the hook, the classifier and the user interface. The four cells draw a different thing: the four gates standing in order. In the strip's fourth cell a single route splits into two strokes — one check, one cross — so allow and block develop together. The plate sits at the end of 4.1, before the 4.2 heading, costing the prose six lines and pushing that heading to line 177; the 9 anchors in the two registries pointing past line 170 each move by six. Both language files go from 560 to 566 lines. Hand-inked drawings 30 to 31, plates inside the prose 4 to 5, plates per edition 164 to 165. 442 builder tests green.

A table at the foot of 8.2 lines the 22 lifecycle events up by category, whether each one can block, and what it is typically for; a flowchart at the head of the section sorts them into six groups, and four configuration samples show the hooks/matcher/command shape. The table gives names, the filmstrip gives the beat. The four cells run: a bell ringing between two curved walls (the event), a hook dropping from a crossbar to catch that dot (the matcher), a terminal with a command behind the prompt and three dots printing under it (the handler), and a fourth cell where one filled point forks into two roads — a solid line carrying an arrowhead goes on above, a dashed line cut short by a cross below, so going through and being stopped develop in the same cell. The fork there is not the one 4.1 drew: there a single call splits into passed or stopped and the call itself stays the same, here the fork decides which next step happens, so after the bell it is the route that moves. The block sits after that 22-row table and before `## 8.3`, costing six lines of prose and pushing that heading to 537; the 3 anchors in the two registries pointing past line 528 each move by six. Both language files go from 1059 to 1065 lines. Hand-inked drawings 31 to 32, plates inside the prose 5 to 6, plates per edition 165 to 166. 442 builder tests green.

Section 7.2 ranks compaction in four levels, and a left-to-right graph in that section already lays the four out in order, each box saying whether it calls a model and what it costs; a second flowchart then walks AutoCompact through its six steps. Order and price did not need redrawing — the strip turns each level into a gesture. The four cells go light to heavy: in the first, three lines still stand and a pair of scissors takes off only the tail, the cut marked by a short dash; in the second the whole span is squeezed, an arrow pushing in from each side, the text barely shorter but its leading collapsed; in the third it folds into three layers, each left with nothing but a eave and a downward arrow, the content tucked inside the paper; the fourth is the heaviest — four faded lines on the left, two freshly inked ones on the right, a thick arrow between them, and a short dashed line under them marking the compaction boundary, where the old conversation snaps and a new session starts below. The first three cells are still the same conversation, cut, squeezed and folded; the fourth has already swapped its content for two new lines, and that is the real difference between the levels: not fewer lines written, but a different memory. The block lands after line 241, before `## 7.3`, costing six lines of prose and pushing that heading to 250; 5 anchors pointing past 241 move by six. Both language files go from 478 to 484 lines. Hand-inked drawings 32 to 33, plates inside the prose 6 to 7, plates per edition 166 to 167. Six of the twenty prose units now carry a drawing; the other fourteen are the next round's debt. 442 builder tests green.

All five plates were watched cell by cell in a browser. Scrolling develops the four frames from left to right instead of lighting them at once: as the strip enters the viewport the first cell is done while the fourth is still a faint ghost, and one screen further all four sit solid. Hovering turns the strip into a carousel, one cell every 0.7 s, walking left to right without looking back. In dark mode currentColor re-inks the whole plate and no patch stays on paper color; under print emulation all four cells draw finished and read side by side — screen, dark and paper all checked. The five-pillar portico is a line drawing: strokes only, no hover hint. The gallery shows 33 cards with bilingual captions, and replay runs with zero console errors. The frame-order test was mutation-checked on the spot: a fifth frame slipped in after the third still passes, and a decorative group moved ahead of the frames goes red at once.

The compression chapter and the Plan Mode chapter each gain an oh-my-pi cross-check, and the Chapter 4 cross-check entry moves to 18.15.0 together with the registry. Every flag and subcommand went through the local 18.15.0 help text again, and the registry re-pins v18.15.0 (commit 3fedf8d5). Eleven anchors shifted with the two insertions, and all 442 builder tests green.

Chapter 14 §14.1.1 gains the gh-gemini-cli cross-check: Plan Mode is default-on, the planning phase pins an explicit read-only tool whitelist, and the agreed plan lands as a collaboratively editable Markdown file; the identity note now names both oh-my-pi and Gemini CLI. Flags and mechanics were re-verified against v0.66.0's docs/cli/plan-mode.md, and the registry re-pins v0.66.0 (commit 97041320). Ten anchors shifted with the insertion, and all 442 builder tests green.

R1 first round of content plates: nine new hand-inked figures -- trust ladder (ch05), memory funnel (ch06), fork filmstrip (ch09), coordinator-versus-fork (ch10), skill stairs (ch11), state dial (ch12), concurrency gate (ch13), plan gate (ch14) and harness wheel (ch15) -- named by ill fences in both languages at four lines each, zero in-figure text, one-stroke pathLength inking; 58 registry anchors shifted with the inserts, gallery and beginner reader regenerated (42 plates). 442 builder tests green.

Translationese sweep: humanizer-zh bilingual per-line de-passivization across all 20 units — Chinese 被-constructions 133 countable lines to 0 (12 whitelist terms such as 被动的/被调用者 remain), English be+participle lines 556 to 15 (16 residues are all copular states or verbatim vendor-doc quotes). Every change is a whole-line replacement with net line counts unchanged, so no registry anchors moved; agents added only what the original implied, keeping terms, versions, counts, attribution and hedges intact. Baseline and residue are reproducible via scripts/measure_translationese.py. 442 builder tests green.

Memory hooks: all 15 chapters gain three waymarkers in both languages -- an In one line hook under the title (reusing each chapter's established courier metaphor), a Difficulty line after the learning objectives (reusing the Start/Core/Advanced tiers and flagging what to skip on a first pass), and Three sentences to keep after the key takeaways; each chapter nets +6 lines per language, and the 102-gloss registry plus 320-diagram anchors were re-aligned through three serialized shift_anchors passes; the new lines re-audited for voice: Chinese actionable passives 0, English 15 lines, level with the post-sweep baseline. 521 builder tests green.

zh: 全书做了第二轮去 AI 味校对：把替读者下结论的评价词（精妙、精巧、巧妙、完美、最强大）换回它所指的机制，把“让我们……”“在当今……”这类模板开场改成直接陈述，删掉列表末尾的自我总结。中文与英文各 60 行原地改写，行号未动，术语表与插图的证据锚点仍逐行可回指。构建器测试 422 项全绿。
en: A second de-AI pass reads every chapter again: verdict words that pre-judge for the reader (ingenious, elegant, clever, perfect, most powerful) give way to the mechanism they point at, template openings such as “Let's...” and “In today's...” become direct statements, and list endings stop praising their own contents. Sixty lines per language were rewritten in place; line numbers did not move, so the gloss and illustration evidence still resolves line by line. 422 builder tests green.

zh: 第 11 章重新校准信任边界：`LoadedFrom` 不再画成从高到低的信誉阶梯，而是画成“来源标签 → 允许的转换”决策图。本地项目技能与第三方插件也需要审查；来源能收紧 Shell 展开和文件提取等加载策略，却不能替内容作安全背书。中英文正文、图版与章末要点同步改写。
第 11 章章徽从一个泛用文件夹重画为带折角的技能页接入两枚插件端子：左侧三行是可读指令，右侧插脚表示能力被装入更大的扩展单元。仍是 `currentColor` 单线 SVG，无 id、脚本或外部资源。
第 13 章把两条时间线拆开：工具可按完成速度竞跑，但最终 `tool_result` 按调用序进入对话轨迹。结果已有 `tool_use_id` 绑定调用，排序不是为了猜 A/B 对应，而是让重放、调试、下一轮上下文与缓存前缀不随机器竞速漂移；正文也补出这份确定性换来的队头阻塞。时序图随之改成“乱序完成 / 有序提交”两栏。
第 13 章章徽重画为三股并行流穿过一枚缓冲闸门，再按三行有序射出；它把流式执行、汇合缓冲和顺序提交压进同一枚 64×64 线稿。
第 8 章把钩子能力从绝对说法改成协议边界：有的事件只允许观察，有的可以改写或阻断；PostToolUse 是否异步取决于下游要不要等待响应，而不是工具是否已经结束。章徽也改成生命周期线上三个事件节点，上下各接一条钩子反射弧。
英文书稿清掉第 3、5、6、8、10、13 章及附录 D 共九处汉字夹杂，并新增整稿级门禁：20 单元的英文 Markdown 一旦出现汉字就按文件与行号失败，唯一豁免精确到附录 D 术语表的第二列；反例测试保证汉字若漏进该表的定义列仍会失败。规则同步写进贡献指南。顺手修正英文反模式提示中的冠词错误。构建器测试 419 项全绿。
英文版前言补回开篇“御舆：从造车到 Agent”：引《考工记》“一器而工聚焉者，车为多”，列出舆、辕、辐、軎辖、轼、御六行构件与 Harness 运行时的对应表，再以孔子论輗軏、甲骨文“舆”字收束到书名由来；英文读者第一次在书内读到 Yù Yú 与 Yú Shū 的来历，新开篇的术语也各得一枚白话气泡。
两处减动效遗漏补齐：纸面的平滑滚动在读者要求减少动态时退为即时跳转，站点门户的卡片入场改为静态落位、悬停只留墨色变化；两项各加一条契约测试，防止模板再生成时丢失守卫。

全书 26 份插图（20 枚章徽、4 幅篇题刻、老驿卒与扉页车图）按开源项目 yang0/handraw-style 的画风体系重绘：FD-001 东方墨线 Editorial 配 C-32 炭黑与 C-15 朱砂，纯几何笔触在 art.py 硬契约内完成；设计令牌随之转版——青铜三色改为炭墨三阶，圆角改手裁不对称四角，章印改朱砂手盖章，辐轮装饰手绘化，Mermaid 图版主题同步墨化并清缓存重渲 314 张。动画分三层：滚动自绘（ink-draw/march）、角色动词（hover 唤醒，含封面车轮随读滚转）、文字 ink-rise 与扉页阶梯落墨，全部收进 screen + reduced-motion + view() 三重守卫，打印与减动效自动落回静态成品；新增动画预算与守卫契约防回归。构建器测试 422 项全绿。
en: Chapter 11 recalibrates its trust boundary. `LoadedFrom` is no longer drawn as a reputation ladder from high to low; it is a decision map from source tag to permitted transformation. Local project skills and third-party plugins still require review. Provenance can tighten loading policy around Shell expansion and file extraction, but cannot vouch for content. Prose, plate and takeaway changed together in both languages.

Chapter 11's emblem is no longer a generic folder. A folded skill sheet now plugs into two plugin terminals: three strokes on the left stand for readable instructions, while the pins on the right show that capability joining a larger extension unit. It remains a single-line `currentColor` SVG with no ids, scripts or external assets.

Chapter 13 now separates two timelines: tools may race to completion, while final `tool_result` blocks enter the conversation trace in call order. `tool_use_id` already binds result to call, so ordering is not a guess about A versus B; it keeps replay, debugging, the next turn's context and cache prefixes from drifting with machine timing. The prose now names the head-of-line blocking paid for that determinism, and the plate contrasts out-of-order completion with ordered submission.

Chapter 13's emblem now draws three parallel streams passing through a buffer gate and leaving as three ordered arrows, putting streaming execution, convergence and ordered submission into one 64×64 line drawing.

Chapter 8 replaces absolutes with protocol boundaries: some event handlers may only observe, while others can rewrite or block; whether PostToolUse should be asynchronous depends on whether downstream work must consume its response, not on whether the tool has ended. Its emblem is now a lifecycle line with three event nodes and hook reflex arcs above and below it.

Nine stray Han fragments were removed from the English manuscripts of Chapters 3, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 13 plus Appendix D. A whole-manuscript gate now reports the file and line for any recurrence across the twenty English units; its only exemption is precisely Appendix D's second table column, and a negative test proves Han in that table's definition column still fails. The contributor guide records the rule, and the English anti-pattern callout loses a stray article error. 419 builder tests green.

The English foreword regains the opening that explains the book's own name: the Kǎo Gōng Jì line on the chariot as the artifact that gathers the most crafts, a six-row table pairing carriage body, shafts, spokes, axle fittings, crossbar and driving with their harness counterparts, Confucius on the nǐ and yuè, the oracle-bone reading of yú, and how Yù Yú and Yú Shū became the title. The new section's terms join the plain-language layer.

Two reduced-motion gaps close: the sheet's smooth scrolling falls back to an instant jump when the reader asks for less motion, and the site portal's card entrance becomes static placement with ink-and-border hover feedback only. A contract test pins each against regeneration.

All twenty-six illustrations—twenty emblems, four part plates, the old courier and the cover chariot—are redrawn through the style system of the open-source project yang0/handraw-style: FD-001 Dynamic East-Asian Ink Editorial with C-32 charcoal and C-15 cinnabar, pure geometric strokes inside the art.py contract. The design tokens follow: the bronze trio becomes a charcoal ink scale, corners are cut by hand, seals are stamped in cinnabar, the spoke-wheel ornament is hand-inked, and the Mermaid theme re-inks with all 314 diagrams re-rendered from a cleared cache. Motion ships in three layers—scroll-driven self-drawing, character verbs that wake on hover, and ink-rise text with a staggered cover—behind the screen + reduced-motion + view() triple guard, so print falls back to the finished drawing; motion-budget and guard contracts now pin the layers against regressions. 422 builder tests green.

zh: 章首的家具搬到了章末：「本章新词」面板此前坐在开篇，是那里最高的一块——中文版第 2 章列 22 个词，它压在三张罗盘卡之上，正文第一句被推到第二页。现在开篇只留章题、白话导读带、罗盘三卡与来源锚点，正文从章首就开场；面板改到章末收束一章，与按语、车辙同在一处。
面板自身从「框」改成「读」：撤掉虚线边框、底色与每行前的 ┄ 分隔符，一个词一行、词后一枚金点接白话释义，纸上两栏排。它不再是一块要看进去的板子，而是一段能顺着读完的清单。
能跨页的清单不许落单：上一版有一页只剩半句 “every time” 与一行注记；面板改到章末之后，又有一页整张空白——词表最后那 1.6px 的内边距画不进版心，Chromium 就为它单留一张纸。现在纸上面板整块不拆（`break-inside:avoid`：22 个词两栏排只占版心三分之一，永远放得下），每一行的空气改记在行首而不是行尾，注记从词表之后移到词表之前。
圆角收敛成两枚加一个圆：`--r-1`（4px）转一张标签、`--r-2`（10px）转一个盒子，`999px` 只留给真是胶囊的东西（3px 的标题条、滚动条滑块）。此前同一张纸上排着七种半径——第五枚圆角就是同一张纸上多出来的一本书。
虚线只说一件事：这个词带白话注。线路图例、全书路线、按语集与引注清单的分隔虚线一律改实线；纸上还留虚线的只有 `.gloss` 与构建器自己报错的那块图版。
目录的页码排成一列：篇号从描边空心改为实墨（空心数字印在纸上像一块没吃上墨的版），条目与页码之间接一段金色点线引导，页码用等宽数字右对齐。
封面铺满整张纸：内框由 `border` + `outline` 的双线改回单框（双线读起来像重了一次版），纸上整页自书眉铺到书脚（`justify-content:space-between`），底部一条作者 / 版本 / 日期 / 许可收住。朱红在纸上重调为 `#9C4630`——屏幕上的 `#B4472F` 印到激光打印机的纯白纸上，会把整套土色系烧穿。
章末的装饰回到尺度：车辙收窄到 19rem、透明度 .9，纸上的罗盘卡减一层内边距。
门禁跟上：`DesignVocabulary` 与 `ChapterOpening` 共 13 项契约，多一枚圆角、多一处虚线、面板重新开篇、或封面回到双线，构建测试即红。构建器测试 417 项全绿。
en: The furniture moved off the chapter opener. The card of new terms sat at the head and was the tallest block there — Chapter 2 lists 22 terms in Chinese, and under it the three compass cards pushed the chapter's first sentence to page two. An opener now carries its title, the plain-language band, the compass and its source anchors, and the prose starts where it should; the card closes the unit instead, beside the keeper's line and the ruts.

The card reads across instead of looking boxed: no dashed frame, no tinted ground, no ┄ tie per row — one term to a line, a gold dot between term and plain wording, two columns on paper. It is a list you finish now, not a plate you look inside.

A list that may break across sheets must not break alone: one page held nothing but the clause “every time” and a caption line, and once the card moved to the tail another sheet came out entirely blank — 1.6px of bottom padding that would not fit the text block was enough for Chromium to reserve a page for it. On paper the plate no longer breaks at all (`break-inside:avoid`: 22 terms in two columns is a third of the text block and always fits), each row keeps its air above rather than below, and the note leads the list.

Two corners and a circle: `--r-1` (4px) turns a tag, `--r-2` (10px) turns a box, and `999px` is left to what really is a pill (the 3px title bar, a scrollbar thumb). Seven radii shared one sheet before — a fifth corner is a fifth book on the same page.

A dashed line means exactly one thing: this term carries a gloss. The route legend, the book's road, the keeper's notes and the citation list separate their rows with solid rules now; on paper only `.gloss` and the build's own missing-diagram plate keep a dash.

The contents page sets its folios in a column: part numerals are inked rather than outlined (a hollow numeral reads as a plate that failed to take ink), gold dotted leaders run from entry to page number, and the folios are tabular and right-aligned.

The cover fills the sheet it is given: the double frame (`border` plus `outline`) is one frame now, the page runs kicker to foot with `justify-content:space-between`, and author / edition / date / licence close it at the bottom. Cinnabar re-inks on paper to `#9C4630` — the screen's `#B4472F` burns straight through the earth palette on a laser printer.
The ornament at a chapter's foot came back to scale: the wheel ruts narrow to 19rem at .9 opacity, and compass cards lose a layer of padding on paper.

The gates say so: `DesignVocabulary` and `ChapterOpening`, 13 contracts in all, fail the build over a fifth radius, a second dashed rule, a card that opens a chapter, or a cover that frames itself twice. 417 builder tests green.

zh: 扉页改为自绘：一辆四马单辕、圆盖三十辐的古车白描矢量图，取代原先从仓库封面位图裁切重染的做法。构建器从此不派生也不写入任何位图，纸面同时撤掉那层会把图版光栅化的滤镜；中文版整书 HTML 由 5.6 MB 降到 5.2 MB，PDF 由 16.1 MB 降到 15.7 MB。
章首页的罗盘回到三卡一行：A4 版心只有 665px，永远低于窄屏断点，于是三张卡在纸上竖成一列、章首半页空着。现在纸上与屏幕同为三列，罗盘连同新词面板一页收齐。
标题不再自我重复：前言的眉题与它自己的大标题同字，改为不渲染眉题。
措辞按单元类型走：罗盘三张卡原先一律写「本章」，而前言讲的是全书、附录不是章；新词面板同样分「开篇新词 / 本章新词 / 本附录新词」三种称呼。
手绘的线路进了正文：每章章眉下多一条走线——焊点、支线、两处抬弯，由单元 id 定种，20 章没有两条相同，重建时又一根根回到原处；四类提示块的 ✦ ⚠ ↗ ◎ ※ 字体符号换成手写墨记（中文版 74 处）；小节之间的 ❖ 改为一对手绘焊盘夹一段耦合线（111 处）。都是 currentColor 的内联矢量，屏幕、暗色与纸面共用一份。
英文版不再中英夹杂：来源页每一行的读取快照、许可声明与用途说明都是本书自己写的中文，此前整段照登在英文页上。现在 35 条来源的 title / authority / snapshot / license / scope 一律配英文镜像字段，渲染按语言取值；两条社区帖的中文标题也给了英译，原文仍可凭 URL 与帖子号回溯。门禁随之收紧：镜像缺失、或镜像里仍带汉字，构建直接失败。
标点按语言走：英文版的提示块标签与「Source anchors」后面挂的是全角冒号，整书 142 处；现在冒号随语言切换，英文版归零。新增一条测试，断言英文来源页与罗盘里不出现汉字。
补上一批从未运行的测试：tests/test_pages.py 的共享基类 Config 没有继承 TestCase，封面、版权页、罗盘、目录与来源页的 22 个用例被 unittest 静默跳过。改成 TestCase 后它们真的在跑了，整套 303 个用例全绿；英文版整书 PDF 为 488 页 / 10.8 MB。
来源页不再把一条来源切成两半：每条登记是一枚带边框的卡片，跨页断开就成了两个破框，现在整行 break-inside:avoid，版式契约里也补了这条断言。

分部过渡页多了一条自绘的路：部目标与章表之间横卧一条手绘道路——起点一枚辐轮，每章一枚站圈，站间一块里程石，末站再套一道光环收束这段行程；由部 id 定种，四个部（4/4/4/3 章）画的便不是同一条。章末也补上了车辙：两轮压出的双线一路延伸，末尾散成几段短划，一章原本戛然留白的地方从此有了落笔处。两者同为 currentColor 的内联矢量、不带任何 id，重建时分毫不差；页面测试与版式契约各补了断言。
纸上两处收口：分部过渡页原先顶着上一章的页眉——PDF 的页眉分区表故意跳过了部页，于是「第一部分」那一页右上印的是「前言」；现在每个书签都开自己的一页眉，这张表也从构建流程里拆成了可测的 `pdf_meta()`。主题索引里 COWORKER_TYPE_TELEMETRY 这类长标识符会把点引线挤成一小截，现在术语可断行、引线有 1.2rem 保底，版式契约各补一条。

全书多了一张线路图：目录之后自成一页，把二十个单元画成一条路——前言是路头的辐轮，轮下标 00；十五章是四段蛇形路上依次排开的站圈；附录走虚线，是停在路边的岔线，末尾一枚同心圆收车。图形由种子定形，重建分毫不差；图下的列表把同一条路线用文字再走一遍并带链接，屏幕阅读器与搜索都够得着（图本身 aria-hidden）。纸上为守住一页版心隐去每段目标句——分部过渡页本就用大字重述它——并把铜色重染为深铜。侧栏目录也多了一枚带轮的入口。
修掉一处没人看见的空栏：宽屏规则 nav.rail{display:block} 写在 nav.rail{display:none} 之前，同特异度后写者胜，于是 1360px 以上的屏幕为侧栏预留了 17.5rem，却什么都不画，正文边上一条白。顺序调正，侧栏回来了；版式契约补一条断言，规定「显示」必须写在「隐藏」之后。

白话浮窗不再被裁掉：浮窗原先只在 44rem（704px）以下退回视口底部的说明条，可一个坐在 46rem 行末的术语，浮窗还要向右再伸出 10.5rem——720px 的屏幕上整整 100px 悬在页外，整份文档因此多出一条横向滚动，读者得往右挪才看得懂自己悬停的东西。断点改为算出来的：版心 + 浮窗 = 67rem。另一处更隐蔽——宽表自带横向滚动，会把画在它里面的浮窗一并裁掉，实测 1360px 以上有 13 张表的浮窗整块落在可见单元格之外（悬停什么也没有），其中一张还凭空多出 78px 的假滚动。表格里的术语从此在任何宽度都用底部说明条。两条各补一条 CSS 契约测试，其中一条断言两种触发共用同一份几何，改一处不会忘了改另一处。

纸边外那一列没人认领：宽表在 390px 屏幕上向右伸出 493px，而浏览器在被拖动之前不画滚动条，读者看到的是一列被切掉一半——以为那就是最后一列。外壳现在带真正的 tabindex="0"，图版框早就有的那根细铜色滚动条也分它一份（原先 CSS 里写的 tab-index:0 根本不是个属性，从来没生效过）；代码块同理，最长的一行伸出 1555px，键盘此前完全够不着。实测按 14 次右方向键，能把 471px 的隐藏部分一路走到底，铜色描边落在板内不被裁掉。中英两版按 390 / 720 / 1360px 重扫全书：越界盒子 0，无人认领的横向滚动 0。

长名字终于有地方可以断了：中文正文是两端对齐的，下一根词如果整根放不下，这一行就会被拉成字距空洞。桌面宽度上量到 56 个各自占掉 30% 以上行宽、且完全无从下刀的 `<code>`/`<a>`，最狠的 `getFeatureValue_CACHED_MAY_BE_STALE` 在 390px 上独占 96% 行宽。CSS 修不了——对照实验里 `line-break:normal` 一点没变，`overflow-wrap:anywhere` 只让四个样本中的一个多断了一次，而显式 `<wbr>` 把它们拆成 7 到 13 段：`overflow-wrap` 既不制造“优先断点”，也不参与 min-content 计算，所以纸面上它连早先附录 B 那张被顶出版心的表都没真正救回来。新加的 `soften_long_names()` 是全书最后一趟（术语匹配与目录都得按原文读，不能被切开），只看 ≥12 字符的连续串，且只在 `_`、`/` 与 camelCase 边界下刀，`<pre>`/`<svg>`/标题/HTML 实体一律不动，普通英文词永不被切断。同一段落开合两次截图对照，中英两版按 390–1440px 重扫：越界盒子 0，无人认领的横向滚动 0。

章末不再把一张空纸留在身后：车辙原先孤零零排在单元末尾，纸面上它连同那点留白放不下时，整张纸就空着——中文版 3 张、英文版 2 张这样的页。现在车辙与它收束的那一段缝成一整块（超过一页高的尾巴不缝），另有一处更隐蔽：章块 2.2rem 的屏幕下边距在纸上成了版心够不着的气口，Chromium 会为它单独留一张纸，而下一单元的强制换页使它永久化——纸上这条内边距归零。两版重印后空白纸 0 张，而这条约束现在由构建自己把关：PDF 落盘前逐页扫一遍正文带（顶栏与页脚之间，文字、矢量、位图都算内容），一张只剩页眉与页码的纸直接让构建失败。修订说明也顺手排了版：笔记里的反引号改成真的代码元素，长标识符的断点从逐单元改到整书装配后统一施加，因为前置与后置内容从不走单元管线——一条引用 `getFeatureValue_CACHED_MAY_BE_STALE` 的修订说明，此前把整份文档在 390px 屏幕上顶出 37px。

书名里那两个词终于有了白话注：`Agent Harness`（智能体线束）与主循环此前在通俗层查无此词——读者翻开第一章，最先撞上的恰恰是这两个没人解释的词。补进两条 core 词条，中英词形齐备，比方用书自己的比喻：马只出力气，辕、衡、车厢决定它拉什么、走哪条路。代价从章首面板的上限里出：一章最多 22 个新词，第一、二章原本就顶在 22，于是把「串行」「快照」两个中文读者一望即知的通用词下调为 extra，附录 D 照旧可查。一处写错的证据指针（Main Loop 指到了 Agent Harness 那一行）被 validate_plain 当场拦下——这道门禁第一次在真数据上证明自己管用。顺带把仓库自己报的数校准：附录 D 是 122 条术语而非 100，白话注 102 条（45 条 core），主题索引 116 个词条，图版每版 157 张、合计 314 张；新增 `test_docclaims` 把这些数字钉回数据——措辞改了会失败，数对不上也会失败。还收回了一处会被读者数出来的错：第 8 章导读带原本写「26 个生命周期事件」，而正文那张「所有 26 个事件」的汇总表实际只有 22 行——白话层从此只说事件覆盖的类别，不再复述一个正文支撑不了的数字；附录 D 与第 13 章的英文导读带也补齐了中文一侧已有的字段与「数字多为示意」的范围。

中文版书末主题索引此前一条中文词条都没有：附录 D 把每个术语登在「英文原名」列，构建器也只读那一列，于是刚在第七章读到「自动压缩」的读者，得先想到去 A 底下找。现在译名列同样成词——按 `/` 拆开，一条英文术语带几个译名就生成几条——122 条中文词条排在 Z 之后自成一块（`中` 的字典序天然靠后，不必为它写特例），块标题取「中文」。英文版不会被这些行搅乱：当前语言没有词条的行在渲染时直接跳过。索引从 116 条长到 238 条，块下另配一行排检说明——全书只有这一块按部首笔画排，不写出来读者只会以为是乱堆。
手机上读中文正文，字距会被拉成一条条沟：一行放不下 `CompactionResult` 这类长名字时，整个词掉去下一行，剩下六七个汉字被两端对齐摊满整行。英文有连字可退，中文没有，于是 30rem 以下把中文版正文改成左对齐、右缘参差——宽版心照旧两端对齐，纸面不受影响。

来源登记从 35 条扩到 49 条，多出来的 14 条全取自 GitHub 开源生态：claude-code-router、opencode、OpenHands、Agent Client Protocol、Playwright MCP、Claude Code Action、Claude Code Templates、modelcontextprotocol/servers、dxt、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Superpowers、claude-mem、learn-claude-code。它们的位置写得很清楚：**对照面，不是依据**——正文的每条技术论断仍只由官方文档、Anthropic 研究博客、MCP 规范与 Claude Code 仓库本身支撑，生态仓库只回答另一个问题：同一层边界在别人手里会长成什么形状（一层可换的模型路由、另一种上下文路线、第二份协议、无人值守时权限如何退化、能力封装单位能长多大）。许可是硬门槛：只收 MIT / Apache-2.0 一类宽松许可，AGPL 的两个候选直接排除；每个 tag 都用 GitHub API 解引用成完整 40 位 SHA（引用式 tag 再走 `/git/tags`），许可读各仓库 LICENSE 原文而不是搜索摘要，MCP 项目那条读到的正是 MIT → Apache-2.0 的过渡声明。核对过程中抓到两处「登记即写错」：`sst/opencode` 已迁到 `anomalyco/opencode`，旧 URL 只剩 301；Gemini CLI 的 README 开头已声明免费档自 2026-06-18 起由 Antigravity CLI 承接——两条都写进 `snapshot`，因为复制一份已过期的自我描述比不登记更坏。新条目挂到章首罗盘后，第 12、15 章各 9 枚来源 chip；`test_sources` 的 20 道门禁（含「每条来源至少被一个单元引用」，未挂上的条目不让留在登记里）全绿，CREDITS 的分族条数与 STRUCTURE 的 kind 分布同步重钉。

原理这一层补上了：45 个 core 术语各得一句「为什么非这样不可」，术语浮窗从两行长成三行——白话定义、为什么、比方；书末另起「原理札记」一页，把每条理由排在提出它的那一章下面，章题可点回正文。理由不是新写的：每一句都取自正文自身的论证，`why_evidence` 必须落在代码围栏之外的正文、且含该术语已登记的词形，中英各要一条，上限中文 52 字、英文 190 字符（实测最长 46 与 169）。这道门禁当场拒掉三处指针：一条英文证据写错了目录名，两条落在正文把句首大写的加粗词形上——`Cancellation propagation` 与 `Runtime validation` 因此进了词形表，而不是把指针改去一句更弱的话。纸上术语列定宽 6.4rem，最长的 `immutability` 仍占满一行；44rem 以下两栏并成一栏时行钉一并解除，此前术语与理由会叠进同一格。中文版 455→461 页、英文版 493→499 页，两版空白纸仍 0 张。

三处正文自己跟自己矛盾的数字落定了——这是本书第一次动正文，且只动数字与被漏掉的那一项。第 8 章通篇说「26 个生命周期事件」，而它自己那张汇总表只有 22 行：现在正文写「本章按功能分组介绍其中 22 个」，`HOOK_EVENTS` 数组本身不再被断言一个数。§13.5.1 标题写「三个维度」，正文与图都是五个，而「前四个维度」后头列的其实是字段名、还漏了 model：标题改为五个，那句话按图重写。工具数在三处分别是 45+、六十多个，与附录 B 逐条数出来的 55：统一为 55，附录 B 开头也第一次报出「12 类 / 55 个」，第 13 章那句 0.1–0.3ms × N 的启动开销随之从 6–18ms 改为 5.5–16.5ms。新增 5 项门禁盯「说的数与表的数不是同一个数」这一类错：章首声明的事件数必须等于表里的行数，附录 B 的行数必须等于全书任何引用它的句子与它自己的算术，缓存维度以图版画出的枚数为准，被替换掉的旧措辞只要再出现在正文或仓库文档里就让测试红。正文改动共 24 行（中英各 12），另加两份 README 与章首罗盘各 4 行，行号一处未动，白话层的证据指针全部复验通过；正文改动没有挪动任何一页，多出来的那一页是这条修订说明自己挤出来的。顺带修掉 Book CI 里一个拼错的 action 输入——`if-no-files-available` 并不是 upload-artifact 的输入，GitHub 对不认识的键只给一条注解、步骤照样绿，于是「产物为空就让构建失败」这道门从未真的生效；现在这个键名由一项测试钉住。构建器测试 375 项全绿。

只出现在反引号里的术语也有虚线了：全书一半的行话，读者与它的第一面就是代码写法——`AbortController`、`isConcurrencySafe` 混在句子里时，纸上没有悬停可查，附录 D 也得先想到英文原名。通俗层现在把虚线画到行内代码的首现处；但只画「读不成普通词」的形状——带 `_`、数字或驼峰接缝的标识符——`Streaming` 这样的普通词仍等正文，免得整页铺满虚线；`<pre>` 图版一律不画，图版整块来读，虚线还会打断照抄。新覆盖面立刻被面板上限检验：第 2 章中英两版因此到了 23 个新词，超出 22 一格——按门禁本意下调登记册，`union-type`（联合类型）全书仅 3 处、又是纯类型语法词，降为 extra 并撤掉原理句（core 与原理句同从 45 减到 44），`AbortController` 补进两语版面板；浮窗在代码里仍是同款三行白话注，等宽字体照旧。构建器测试 378 项全绿。

书里从此有一个会说话的边角：每章章末的车辙上方多一行按语，二十行白话由一位老驿卒说他刚跑完的那一段——前言提主循环，附录 D 提总账，第 11 章提醒租来的鞍具要先摸刃口。按语与一枚自绘的斗笠灯笼（`keeper.svg`，全书第 26 份线描，仍过装载器的全部禁令：无 id、无外链、`currentColor`）缝成一块落在车辙之前，纸上两者不跨页拆开，屏幕上悬停时驿卒微微前倾一下。书末「按语集」自成一页，把二十行按阅读顺序收齐、每行的章题链回正文——章末那一行只是路过，能被一次读完与搜到的地方在合集。这一层有自己的门禁（术语锁）：每句必须含一个已注册词形，且那个词形要真的站在它那一单元的源文件里，中文 ≤36 字、英文 ≤130 字符，英文版夹汉字即错，二十个单元缺一条或多一条没主的都让构建失败。锁当场退回五句：第 1 章的中文正文写的其实是 `Agent Harness` 而非「智能体线束」，第 14 章写「规划模式」与 「Plan Mode」而不写「计划模式」，附录 D 的英文列首字母大写——锁认字面不认同义，五句照源文件的拼法重排才过（这也顺带证明它不是摆设）。装配后的对账多一道：正文里的按语数、合集里的行数、真有按语的单元数三者必须相等，统计行从此报出 keeper notes；`--no-plain` 把这一层整块关掉，关掉后书与昨天一样。新增 `tests/test_notes.py`（门禁正反两面、按语集成页与回链、驿卒图的体积上限、再拿真实的 `notes.json` 与 20 份单元源文件跑它自己的门禁），`test_art` 把 `.kp-art` 计入必须有样式的槽位。两道门随后补上：按语里的数字要么不写，写了就得让测试重算得出来——附录 B 那行从「五十五枚」改写成「55 枚腰牌」，因为拼出来的数目对任何门禁都是隐形的，这本书正是被写成汉字的约数骗过一次；纸面契约钉住 `.keeper` 不与车辙跨页拆开、合集每一行 `.kn-row` 不被拦腰切断、驿卒悬停的前倾在纸上归零。还有一处是自己跟自己矛盾：`--no-plain` 在 STRUCTURE 里写明整层关掉、连导读带一起关，代码里导读带却直接从 manifest 取文，术语、面板、tier 徽、原理札记、按语集都随空层消失了，只有它漏网——而这个开关正是用来对比「开这层与不开这层」的，漏一块就等于对比结果不可信。装配时对账再添一道：开着带数必须等于单元数、关掉必须为 0，统计行从此报出 lead bands；另有一条端到端测试真跑 `--check --no-plain` 双语，盯着三个归零。纸上的主题索引一直没有页码：每一行末尾本来就留着一枚空位，宽度和页码相仿，屏幕上它该被藏起来——屏幕没有页；可打印规则继承了这条隐藏，PDF 后处理也只认目录行，于是书末那一页每行只报章题、不报第几页，按索引找地方的人扑个空。先试过照目录那趟的做法：在纸上搜术语，把数字落在行末。此路不通——PyMuPDF 的 `search_for` 是子串匹配，`Session` 会把 `SessionStart` 那一行也认成自己；而一个锚点常被几十行共用，行面几乎一样，落点无从唯一确定。打印实测还发现 Chromium 漏写了其中一行的链接注释，靠注释定位同样不可信。于是改成打印两趟：第一趟只用来量，`pdf.measure()` 读 Chromium 留在 PDF 里的命名目标，得到每个单元落在哪张纸；页码由 `pages.fill_index_folios()` 写进行里本来预留的空位——按行自己链接的锚点认领，不按头词的字面，于是两个拼法相近的词各得其所；第二趟才是真书。空位早就留好了宽度，翻页理当不动，这件事不靠祈祷：`pdf.folio_drift()` 在第二趟重读目的地，任何一个页码与量到的不符，构建直接失败。对账再添两道：索引里每一行必须恰有一枚空位，`pdf_meta` 交给打印趟的行表必须与页面真正落下的行同名同序——行表与页面错开一位，每个数字都会落到别人的头上。代价是出 PDF 时每种语言多打印一趟；屏幕上那枚空位照旧隐藏，反正页码只在那摞纸上才说得出意义。数字也确实占了纸：两栏各行短了一截，整书多出一页——多出来的那一页有内容，不是空转。构建器测试 402 项全绿。
en: A drawn cover, not a cropped one: the front page now carries a hand-inked four-horse chariot in the same line idiom as the emblems, replacing the raster derived from the repository's cover image. The builder writes no bitmap at all, and the print filter that was rasterising plates is gone; the Chinese HTML fell from 5.6 MB to 5.2 MB and the PDF from 16.1 MB to 15.7 MB.

The compass is three cards across again: the A4 type block is 665px, always under the narrow-screen breakpoint, so on paper the cards stacked into one tall column and half the opener sat empty. Opener and new-terms panel now fit a single sheet.
Titles stopped repeating themselves: the foreword's eyebrow was its own H1, so it renders no eyebrow at all.
Wording follows the unit type: the compass said 本章 of the foreword and the appendices, which are not chapters; the panel is now 开篇新词 / 本章新词 / 本附录新词 to match.

Wiring drawn, not typed: every chapter head now closes on a hand-run trace -- pads, stubs, two bends lifted off the baseline -- seeded from the unit id, so all 20 differ and a rebuild redraws each one exactly where it was. The five callout marks (✦ ⚠ ↗ ◎ ※) are inked drawings rather than font glyphs (74 in the Chinese edition), and the ❖ between sections became a pair of pads around a coupling line (111 of them). All inline currentColor vectors, so screen, dark mode and paper share one copy.

The English book stops code-switching: every line of the sources page -- access snapshot, licence note, and what the source is used for -- is text this book wrote itself, and until now it shipped in Chinese inside the English edition. All 35 entries now carry English mirrors of title, authority, snapshot, license and scope, and the renderer picks by language; the two forum threads keep a searchable English title too, with the original reachable through the URL and post id. The registry now refuses to build if a mirror is missing or still contains Han characters.

Punctuation follows the language: the English edition wore a full-width colon after every callout label and after Source anchors -- 142 of them -- and now carries none. A new test asserts the English sources page and compass contain no Han characters at all.

Twenty-two tests that never ran: the shared Config base class in tests/test_pages.py did not extend unittest.TestCase, so discovery silently dropped the cover, imprint, compass, contents and registry cases. They run now; the suite is 303 tests green, and the English PDF stands at 488 pages / 10.8 MB.
A source entry is no longer cut in half: each registry row is a bordered card, and a page break through one left two broken frames. Rows now hold together, and the layout contract asserts it.

The part dividers gained a drawn road: between the part's goal and its chapter list runs one hand-inked route — a spoked wheel to start, a station ring per chapter, a milepost between each pair and a second ring where the leg closes, seeded by the part id so the four parts (4/4/4/3 chapters) do not roll the same road. Chapter ends picked up their wheel ruts: two tracks that run on and fray into short dashes, giving the bare band a chapter used to stop in something to end on. Both are currentColor inline vectors carrying no id, identical rebuild to rebuild; the page tests and the layout contract each assert them.

Two paper fixes: a part divider used to wear the running head of the chapter that ended before it, because the PDF section map skipped part pages — every bookmark now opens its own head, and that map came out of the build path into a testable `pdf_meta()`. And a long identifier such as COWORKER_TYPE_TELEMETRY squeezed its dotted leader down to a stub; terms may now break, with a 1.2rem floor under the leader.

The book has a route map now: a page of its own after the contents draws all twenty units as one road -- the foreword the spoked wheel at the head of it, wearing 00; the fifteen chapters station rings set out along four serpentine legs; the appendices a dashed siding running off the end, closed by a target ring. Seeded, so the map is the same map rebuild to rebuild. The list under it walks the same route in text and carries the links, because the picture is aria-hidden and a search box cannot reach a drawn number. On paper the per-leg goals are dropped -- each part divider already sets its goal in large type -- which keeps the page inside one sheet, and the bronze is re-inked for the printer. The sidebar picked up a wheeled entry of its own.

One empty gutter nobody noticed: the wide-screen rule nav.rail{display:block} was written before nav.rail{display:none}, so at equal specificity the later one won and every screen 1360px or wider reserved 17.5rem for a sidebar that never drew. The order is fixed, the rail is back, and the layout contract now asserts that showing must be written after hiding.

The plain-language popover stopped being cut off. It fell back to a bottom caption only below 44rem (704px), but a term sitting at the end of the 46rem measure needs another 10.5rem to its right, so on a 720px screen 100px of the bubble hung outside the page and the whole document grew a sideways scrollbar the reader had to follow just to read a definition. The breakpoint is now arithmetic: measure + bubble = 67rem. A less visible case sat behind it -- a wide table scrolls sideways and clips whatever is painted inside it, so at 1360px and above 13 of the book's tables hid their bubbles entirely outside the visible cells (hovering showed nothing) and one grew 78px of phantom scroll. Terms inside a table take the bottom caption at every width. Both rules have CSS contract tests, one of which pins the two triggers to the same geometry.

A column cut off at the edge belonged to nobody. On a 390px screen the widest appendix table ran 493px past the box while the browser painted no scrollbar until dragged, so the reader saw a half-sliced column and took it for the last one. The wrapper now carries a real tabindex="0", and the thin bronze bar the plate frames have always had was given to tables too -- the `tab-index:0` previously written in the stylesheet is not a CSS property at all and never applied. Code plates got the same stop: their longest line overhangs by 1555px and was unreachable without a mouse. Fourteen presses of ArrowRight now walk a 471px block to its end, with the ring drawn inside the frame. Both editions were re-swept at 390 / 720 / 1360px: no boxes off the page, no unadvertised sideways scroll.

Long identifiers finally got somewhere to break. Chinese prose is justified, so when the next token cannot fit, the line is stretched into a channel of whitespace. At desktop width 56 inline `<code>`/`<a>` tokens were measured that each took more than 30% of a line with no break opportunity at all -- `getFeatureValue_CACHED_MAY_BE_STALE` filled 96% of a 390px line. CSS cannot fix this: in a controlled comparison `line-break:normal` changed nothing, `overflow-wrap:anywhere` bought one extra break out of four samples, while an explicit `<wbr>` split the same tokens into 7 to 13 fragments. `overflow-wrap` creates no preferred break and feeds no min-content width, which is also why it had never really rescued the Appendix B table that overflowed the page box. The new `soften_long_names()` runs last over the whole unit (term matching and the outline have to read the text as written), examines only runs of twelve characters or more, cuts only at `_`, `/` and camelCase boundaries, and leaves `<pre>`, `<svg>`, headings and HTML entities alone, so ordinary English words are never hyphen-hacked. The same paragraph was screenshotted with and without the pass; both editions were re-swept from 390 to 1440px -- no boxes off the page, no unadvertised sideways scroll.

Chapters stopped leaving a blank sheet behind them. The ruts sat alone at the end of a unit, and when they and their trailing gap would not fit, the whole sheet stayed empty — 3 such pages in Chinese, 2 in English. Each pair is now stitched to the block it closes (a tail taller than a page is left alone). A second, subtler one: the article's 2.2rem bottom padding is air between chapters on screen, but on paper a strip the text block cannot reach, so Chromium kept a sheet alive just to paint it and the next unit's forced break made it permanent; that padding is zero in print now. Both editions reprinted with 0 empty sheets, and the build now polices that itself: before the PDF is written every page's body band is swept (text, vector and image all count as content) and a sheet carrying nothing but a running head and a folio fails it. The revision notes were typeset too — backticked names became real code elements, and the break points for long identifiers moved from per-unit to the assembled book, because front and back matter never runs the unit pipeline: a note quoting `getFeatureValue_CACHED_MAY_BE_STALE` had pushed the document 37px past a 390px screen.

The two words in the title finally got a plain gloss. `Agent Harness` and the main loop were absent from the plain layer, so the very first thing a reader meets in Chapter 1 was vocabulary nobody explained. Two core entries went in, forms in both languages, with the book's own comparison doing the work: the horse only pulls, while shafts, yoke and carriage decide what gets hauled and which road it takes. The price came out of the chapter panel's budget -- a unit may carry 22 new terms and Chapters 1 and 2 were already at 22 -- so 串行 and 快照, two words a Chinese reader takes in at a glance, dropped to extra and remain searchable in Appendix D. One mis-aimed evidence pointer (Main Loop landing on the Agent Harness row) was refused outright by validate_plain: the first time that gate proved itself against live data. The repository's own figures were calibrated too -- Appendix D holds 122 terms, not 100; the registry 102, 45 of them core; the subject index 116 entries; 157 plates per edition, 314 in all -- and the new `test_docclaims` pins each of those back to the data, so a reworded sentence fails and a stale number fails. One claim a reader could count and catch went back out: Chapter 8's lead band said 26 lifecycle events, while the table its own chapter labels "all 26 events" lists 22 rows, so the band now names the categories the events cover instead of repeating a figure the manuscript cannot support. The English bands for Appendix D and Chapter 13 were widened to carry what the Chinese ones already said — the related-terms column, and a hedge that covers the cost figures as well as the milliseconds.

The Chinese edition's subject index carried no Chinese headwords at all: Appendix D files every term under its English name and the builder read only that column, so a reader who had just met 自动压缩 in Chapter 7 had to think to look under A. The translation column is a headword source now, split on `/` so a term with several translations contributes several rows, and the 122 Chinese entries form a block of their own after Z -- `中` sorts there by itself, with no special case for it -- headed 中文. The English edition is not disturbed by them: a row with no headword in the language being read is skipped at render time. The index grew from 116 entries to 238, and the block carries one line saying how it is filed -- it is the only part of the book ordered by radical, and left unexplained a reader would take it for a pile.

On a phone, justified Chinese prose stretches into canals: when a line cannot fit a name like `CompactionResult`, the token drops whole to the next row and the half-dozen glyphs left behind are spread across it. English has hyphenation to fall back on and Chinese has nothing to fall back on, so below 30rem the Chinese body text goes ragged-right. Wide screens keep the justified edge, and paper is untouched.

The source registry grew from 35 entries to 49, and the 14 new ones all come from the GitHub open-source ecosystem: claude-code-router, opencode, OpenHands, the Agent Client Protocol, Playwright MCP, Claude Code Action, Claude Code Templates, modelcontextprotocol/servers, dxt, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Superpowers, claude-mem and learn-claude-code. Their standing is stated plainly: they are cross-checks, not authorities -- every technical claim in the text still rests only on the official documentation, Anthropic's research posts, the MCP specification and the Claude Code repository itself, while these repositories answer a different question: what does the same boundary grow into in someone else's hands (a swappable model route, another context strategy, a second protocol, what permissions degrade to when nobody is watching, how large a unit of packaged capability can get). Licensing was the hard filter: MIT and Apache-2.0 family only, two AGPL candidates dropped outright; every tag resolved through the GitHub API to a full 40-character SHA (annotated tags dereferenced via `/git/tags`), and each licence read from the repository's own LICENSE rather than a search snippet -- for the MCP projects that file is the MIT-to-Apache-2.0 transition notice. Two errors the checking caught before they could ship: `sst/opencode` has moved to `anomalyco/opencode`, its old URL a bare 301, and the Gemini CLI README now opens by handing unpaid tiers to Antigravity CLI from 2026-06-18. Both went into `snapshot`, because copying a stale self-description is worse than not registering it. Hung on the chapter compasses, Chapters 12 and 15 carry nine source chips each; all 20 gates in `test_sources` stay green -- including the rule that an entry no unit cites may not sit in the registry -- and the family counts in CREDITS and the kind distribution in STRUCTURE were re-pinned with them.

The layer under the definition: all 45 core terms now carry a reason -- why the thing has to work that way -- so the popover grew from two lines to three (plain definition, why, everyday comparison), and the book closes its front-of-back matter with a page called Why It Works This Way, which files each reason under the chapter that argues it and links the heading back into the text. The reasons are not new copy: every one is the manuscript's own argument, and a `why_evidence` pointer has to land on prose outside a code fence and contain a registered surface form, one line per language, capped at 52 CJK characters and 190 Latin ones (the longest actually written are 46 and 169). The gate refused three pointers as first written: one English path named the wrong directory, and two cited a form the manuscript bolds with a sentence-initial capital -- `Cancellation propagation` and `Runtime validation` went into the form list instead of the pointers being re-aimed at weaker sentences. On paper the term column is 6.4rem wide, so `immutability` still sets on one line, and the narrow-screen collapse now releases the row pins that used to stack term and reason in a single cell. The Chinese edition went from 455 to 461 pages and the English from 493 to 499, both still with no empty sheets.

Three figures the book stated about itself now agree with the tables underneath them. This is the first edit the manuscript has ever taken, and it touches numbers plus one dimension a sentence had dropped. Chapter 8 spoke of 26 lifecycle events while its own summary table lists 22 rows: the text now says the chapter introduces 22 of them, and stops asserting a size for the `HOOK_EVENTS` array itself. Section 13.5.1 was headed Three Dimensions while the prose and its plate draw five, and the sentence about the first four dimensions listed field names and omitted model -- the heading now reads Five and the sentence follows the plate. The tool count stood at 45+ in one place, sixty-odd in two others, and at the 55 rows Appendix B actually enumerates: 55 everywhere now, with the appendix stating its own 12 categories and 55 tools in its opening line, and Chapter 13's startup arithmetic moving from 6-18ms to 5.5-16.5ms at 0.1-0.3ms per tool. Five new gates watch this class of error: the count a chapter claims must equal the rows it prints, the inventory must equal every sentence quoting it and its own arithmetic, the cache dimensions are counted from the plate that draws them, and the superseded wording fails the suite if it reappears anywhere in the book or the repository docs. 24 manuscript lines changed, twelve per language, plus four each in the two READMEs and in the compass questions, with no line moving, so every plain-layer evidence pointer re-verified; the manuscript edits shifted no page at all -- the extra sheet is this note pushing past its own page. One more gate fell out of the same sweep: the CI step passed `if-no-files-available`, which is not an input of upload-artifact at all -- Actions only annotates an unknown key and the job stays green -- so the rule "publish nothing and the build fails" had never actually been live. A test pins the key name now. 375 builder tests green.

Terms that live only inside backticks are annotated now. For half the book's vocabulary a reader's first and only meeting is the code spelling — `AbortController`, `isConcurrencySafe` — and on paper there is nothing to hover, while Appendix D asks first for an English name you may not know. The plain layer draws its dashed line at the first inline-code use of a term, but only for shapes that cannot be read as ordinary words: identifiers carrying underscores, digits, or camel-case seams. `Streaming` still waits for the prose, so the page does not become a field of dashes, and code plates are never touched — a plate is studied as a whole, and dashes break the copy. The new reach was tested by the panel's own budget at once: Chapter 2 grew to 23 new terms against the 22-term cap in both languages, so the registry was trimmed the way the gate intends — union type / 联合类型, used three times in the whole book and pure type-syntax vocabulary, dropped to extra and gave up its principle line (core terms and principle lines both went from 45 to 44), and AbortController took its place on both panels. The bubble over code carries the same three lines as over prose, monospace intact. 378 builder tests green.

The margins got a voice: one line of marginalia now sits above the wheel ruts at the end of every unit, twenty lines spoken by an old postman about the leg he has just run — the foreword naming the main loop, Appendix D the station ledger, Chapter 11 warning that borrowed tack gets its edge checked first. Each line is stitched to a drawn straw hat and lantern (`keeper.svg`, the book's 26th line drawing, still passing every loader ban: no id, nothing external, `currentColor`) and set before the ruts, so on paper the pair never splits across a sheet and on screen the keeper leans when hovered. A back-matter page, The Keeper's Notes, collects all twenty in reading order with each line linked back into its chapter — at the chapter end a note merely passes by; the collection is where it can be read through and searched. The layer carries its own gate, a term lock: a note must contain a registered term form that also stands in that unit's own source file, 36 characters in Chinese and 130 in English, no Han characters in the English edition, and a missing or orphaned note fails the build. The lock sent five drafts back — Chapter 1's Chinese text writes `Agent Harness`, not 智能体线束; Chapter 14 writes 规划模式 and Plan Mode, not 计划模式; Appendix D's English column capitalises Agent Harness — the lock reads spelling, not synonym, so the five were re-aimed at how the source actually spells them, which is how the gate proved itself on live prose. The assembly reconciles three counts now: notes in the body, rows in the collection, and units that have a note must agree, and the build line prints keeper notes; `--no-plain` drops the layer whole and leaves the book as it was. New `tests/test_notes.py` (both sides of every rule, the collection page and its links back, the drawing's size budget, then the shipped `notes.json` against the twenty real unit sources), and `test_art` counts `.kp-art` among the slots that must be styled. Two gates followed: a note may state a number only if a test can recount it, so Appendix B's line now reads 55 tallies instead of the spelled-out figure that is invisible to every scanner — a vague total written in characters is exactly what fooled this book once; and the print contract pins the keeper to the same sheet as its ruts, keeps each collection row from being cut in half, and stops the hover lean on paper. One contradiction of its own went the same way: `--no-plain` is documented as closing the plain layer whole, lead bands included, yet the band took its text straight from the manifest and kept assembling while the marks, panels, chips, principle notes and keeper notes all disappeared — and that switch is precisely how the layer is compared against the bare manuscript, so a leak makes the comparison worthless. The assembly reconciles one more count: bands must equal the units when the layer is on and be zero when it is off, the build line now prints lead bands, and an end-to-end test really runs `--check --no-plain` for both languages. The printed subject index had no page numbers: each row reserved a slot about as wide as a folio, hidden on screen as it should be — a screen has no pages — but the print block inherited that hiding and the PDF pass knew only the contents rows, so a line of the back index named a chapter without naming the sheet, and a reader following the index found nothing. Stamping it like the contents rows was tried first and does not work: PyMuPDF's `search_for` matches substrings, so `Session` would also claim `SessionStart`'s line, and one anchor is shared by dozens of near-identical rows, so no landing point is unique; the measuring print also showed Chromium dropping one row's link annotation, which rules out locating rows by annotation either. The index now takes two prints: `pdf.measure()` reads the named destinations Chromium leaves in the first PDF to learn which sheet each unit landed on, `pages.fill_index_folios()` writes those folios into the slots the rows already reserve — keyed by the anchor each row links to, never by the headword's spelling, so two similarly spelled terms each get their own number — and the second print is the book. The width was reserved, so pagination should not move, and that is an assertion rather than a hope: `pdf.folio_drift()` re-reads the destinations on the final print and the build fails if any number has moved. Two reconciliations came with it: every printed row carries exactly one slot, and the row list handed to the PDF pass must match the rendered index in name and order — off by one, every folio would sit above someone else's headword. The cost is one extra print per language; the slot stays hidden on screen, where a page number has no meaning. The digits do take paper: both columns lost a strip of row and the book gained a sheet, and that sheet carries content rather than furniture. 402 builder tests green.

zh: 纸面留白：篇分隔页的天地留白收紧，分级图例、引注清单与章尾注各自成块、不再被页底切开，正文段落设了孤寡行下限；两语版全书零页顶出版心。
图版尺寸：竖版里实在放不下的长条图，改占一张自己的横向 A4 折页（中文版 15 张、英文版 22 张）；特别高的图按自身比例把高度上限抬到 150–245mm（中文版 6 张、英文版 9 张），不再被压成一团看不清的色块。
图版可检索：删掉打印时套在图版上的一层滤镜——它会把整张图光栅化，图里的字退化成图片、PDF 体积翻倍。改后图版里的文字恢复成真文字，可选中、可检索；中文版 PDF 从 30.8 MB 降到 16.1 MB，英文版从 26.6 MB 降到 11.9 MB。
表格与标签：长标志名（如 CONCURRENCY_SAFE_TOOLS）在构建时插入软断点，不再把整张表顶出版心；来源标签显示完整名称不再截断，题词块继承所在容器的对齐方式。
折页不再碎版：一张横向图版原先会裂成两三页（图在上一页、图题独占下一页，前后还各留一页空白），现在图与图题稳稳落在同一张纸上，中文版省 2 页、英文版省 4 页。
en: Whitespace on paper: part openers breathe less, while the tier legend, the citation list and each chapter's closing notes now hold together as blocks instead of being sliced by the foot of the page, paragraphs got orphan/widow floors, and nothing still spills past the type block in either language.

Plate sizing: a band too wide to fit a portrait column now takes a landscape fold-out of its own (15 in Chinese, 22 in English), and very tall plates raise their own height cap to 150–245mm (6 and 9 respectively) rather than being crushed into an unreadable smear.

Searchable plates: a CSS filter applied to plates for print was rasterising the whole subtree — the words inside a diagram became pixels and the PDF doubled. Those words are real text again, selectable and searchable; the Chinese PDF fell from 30.8 MB to 16.1 MB and the English one from 26.6 MB to 11.9 MB.

Tables and chips: long flag names such as CONCURRENCY_SAFE_TOOLS get soft break points at build time, so one of them can no longer shove an entire table past the type block; source chips show their whole label, and epigraphs inherit the alignment of the container they sit in.

Fold-outs stopped fragmenting: a landscape plate used to break across two or three sheets — drawing here, caption on the next, an empty sheet on either side. Drawing and caption now hold one sheet, saving two pages in Chinese and four in English.

zh: 通俗层：每章一句白话导读带加一个比方；术语首现处画虚线，屏幕悬停出浮窗、纸面退回章首「本章新词」面板；每个小节盖「起步 / 主干 / 进阶」徽，前言据此给出三条阅读路线。术语库 100 条，中文版落 292 处标注、英文版 289 处。
插图：20 枚单元章徽与 4 幅篇题刻，全部手写单线白描、只用 currentColor 上色，一份图同时管屏幕、暗色模式与纸面。
图版配色：正文里 696 条 classDef、192 条 style 自带的 Material/Tailwind 色，构建时按色相重染进本书七组色（蓝→青金、绿→玉、橙黄→铜、红→朱砂、紫→藕、近白→卡纸、其余→素纸）。角色区分保留，色板与正文一致；Markdown 一字未改。纸面上图版高度上限由 200mm 降到 150mm，让半数留白的页面就能容下图，消掉页底大片空洞。
版式：正文栏与图版/表格/代码栏分宽（measure 与 furniture），中文与拉丁字母各配自己的书口宽度；章首、罗盘、新词面板与代码板的留白整体收紧，纸面退回整幅版心。
en: A plain-language layer: a one-sentence lead band and an everyday analogy at the head of every chapter; a dotted underline at each term's first use, opening a popover on screen and falling back to a 'new terms in this chapter' panel on paper; a Start / Core / Advanced stamp on every section, which the foreword's three reading routes are built from. 100 glosses, 292 marks in the Chinese edition and 289 in the English one.
Illustrations: 20 unit emblems and 4 part headpieces, hand-drawn single-weight line art inked entirely in currentColor, so one drawing serves screen, dark mode and paper.

Diagram palette: the 696 classDef and 192 style directives the manuscript brings with it are re-inked at build time by hue into seven book families (blue to sky, green to jade, orange to brass, red to cinnabar, purple to plum, near-white to card, the rest to plain paper). Role distinctions survive, the manuscript is untouched. On paper a plate now caps at 150mm instead of 200mm, so any page with half its column left can host one — which removes most of the holes at the foot of the page.

Typography: the prose measure and the furniture width are now separate, Latin and CJK get different line lengths, and the chapter head, compass cards, term panels and code plates are set tighter — the cap stands down on paper.

zh: 首个离线整书版：20 个单元（前言、15 章、4 附录）合成单文件 HTML/PDF。
每单元注入问题/交付/边界罗盘与来源锚点；314 个 Mermaid 图预渲染为统一主题 SVG。
跨章引用（第N章/附录X）自动链接；附录 D 术语表生成书末主题索引。
en: First offline edition: 20 units (foreword, 15 chapters, 4 appendices) assembled into a single HTML/PDF.
Each unit carries a question/deliverable/boundary compass with source anchors; all 314 Mermaid diagrams pre-rendered as themed SVG plates.
Cross-chapter mentions (Chapter N/Appendix X) auto-linked; the glossary feeds the back-matter subject index.
